summary.en: The split style’s one actor: a 6 px accent seam with a paper key each side, its grip tab, and the chip beside it that names where the result comes from; it carries the engine and the scene machinery of the split scenes.
summary.zh: split 风格唯一的主角：两侧带纸色描边的 6 px 强调色接缝、它的把手，以及把手旁写明结果来源的标签；也承载 split 各场景共用的引擎与场景机制。

fits: Dividing input from result for a whole film.
notFor: Decorative rules; dividing two results of the same kind.

intent.en: One boundary the eye can follow from the first caret to the last frame.
intent.zh: 一条眼睛能从第一个光标一直跟到最后一帧的边界。

content.en: A result (frame, render or page) and its source line for the chip (≤ 52 characters).
content.zh: 一个结果（画格、渲染或页面）和标签上的来源（≤ 52 字符）。

fits.zh: 整支片里分开输入与结果。

notFor.zh: 装饰性的分隔线；分开两个同类结果。

en: The chip names the source and nothing else.
zh: 标签只写来源，别的不写。

fits: any film whose input maps line by line to an output

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
